Name: Add A Room and Attic - Version 1.1 Compatible
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE] 11/03/16 - [/b]All bathroom editions finally addressed & corrected, your refrigerator shall work once more! Bathroom Edition users [b][u]WILL NEED[/u][/b] to download the tilesheet from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2642839]DevilBro[/url]'s mod, "[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299/?]Bathroom After 2nd House Upgrade[/url]". I had made my own tilesheet but there seemed to be some issues with it causing errors with hardcoded items. As always, this file is not authorized to be reuploaded to other sites such as stardewmods.com, stardewvalleymods.net or any other sites that insist on stealing the work of others' for their own personal gain. A special thanks to the ones who have continually followed my mods and also users who have even donated! Most recently, thank you, Kimberly L. and Rachel S. Your generosity will not go unnoticed! Your donations have gone towards my data limit to allow me to bring more files to the community in a timely fashion along with the support of other indie developers. 

[b][UPDATE] 10/28/16 - [/b]Bathroom Editions still have a defect that will not allow you to use your refrigerator. I found that old versions are still working correctly that rely on DevilBro's tilesheet, although I have removed old versions from this page since the 1.1(1) releases. I will have to redo these and reupload them hopefully as soon as today. Thanks for your patience! 

[b][UPDATE] 10/25/16 - [/b]Fridges on bathroom versions are still NOT working correctly. The way it seems, it may be the custom tilesheet or the dimensions of the map (or a mixture of both). I just want to let users know that I am well aware and on the case. I'll post a new version once I finally figure it out.

[b][UPDATE] 10/20/16 -[/b] Users have reported refrigerator problems while using this mod. If this affects you, please let me know in the bug or comment section which version you are using (ie. Single Bed/+Crib/Bathroom Edition, etc.). Bathroom edition with normal-sized kitchen tops as requested by a few users added. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ec5a325l.jpg[/img]

[b][UPDATE] 10/10/16 - [/b]The files added the other night were somehow mixed up so I took the whole thing down until I could rework EVERY VERSION. I've been without internet at my home so I've had to upload everything from my mobile phone data connection so it has been quite the adventure and actually cost me a bit too, but as long as people find it useful I can't complain. Bathroom variations of all sorts added. I've made my own bathroom tilesheet so there is no need to download anything outside of this mod to get it up and running. Kitchen counter tops for all versions shortened. Cellar working fine! Both married & unmarried versions can be found in each file. New and future versions will continue the reversed room due to child glitches and such. If you find this file useful, feel free to endorse! And, as always, if you find a bug, please let me know! Thanks.

[b][UPDATE] 10/08/16-2 - [/b]Added files for final upgrade for unmarried players. Bathroom version in the works..

[b][UPDATE] 10/08/16 - [/b]Added new compatibility patches but only for the marriage candidates as of now.. Others will be coming as soon as I get a chance. Works with version 1.1 of the game. Cellar upgrade appropriate. If updating from a previous release, be sure to remove all of your furniture from the spare/childs rooms, otherwise they may become permanently stuck in the static furniture which is fixable, but unnecessary madness.

[b][img]http://i.imgur.com/b9s8THul.jpg[/img][/b]

[b][UPDATE] [/b]Added a compatibility patch for use with the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/524/?]Farmhouse Basement Mod[/url] by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/16353764]MiniPantsu[/url].

[b][UPDATE][/b] There is a bug with babies AND toddlers! The emptied room taking over the childrens' room still acts as their room so babies will float where the crib is and (I'm guessing from a user reported bug from another mod based on the same kind of thing; Untested by myself) toddlers don't know where to go when it comes bedtime. I used this mod myself however I have never tested the children aspect of it until now [pictured below] [06/03/16]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gcC912ql.png[/img]


[Optional] File added that shortens the kitchen counter top by a few pixels since it is completely useless. 

Paintings in the upstairs created by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/swpau.608055/]swpau[/url] on [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/bath-house-mod-edit-paintings-set-19-5-11pm.113109/]ChuckleFish forums[/url]. 

[v1.2]

FIXED: Files were pointing to unavailable tilesheets. 

[v1.1]

This version adds a FarmHouse2.xnb for an unmarried Starrydewer on house upgrade 2. Includes the married version as well. Attic hatch has been moved up and to the right one pixel to avoid problems in the future.

[v1.0]
For use with the final house upgrade. Marriage version only. Original FarmHouse2.xnb will likely follow. This room & attic are not available for custom wallpaper and floors. Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299]Bathroom in Houseupgrade 2[/url] tilesheet.
